task.title: Reset MFA for a Locked-Out User
task.shortdesc: Let a user who lost or replaced their phone sign in again: clear their multi-factor authentication (MFA), so that they can enroll the new phone.

ul.li: Confirm that the request is genuine. Call the user on the number in the HR system, not the number in the ticket.
Check that the account belongs to an employee. Contractor accounts follow a different process: reassign those tickets to the IAM team.

context.p: For IT service desk analysts. A demonstration document, written for this portfolio from an example message.

step.cmd: In the admin console, find the user and open their profile.

info.note: Don’t select Reset password. It leaves the old phone enrolled.

step.cmd: Ask the user to open the enrollment email and enroll the new phone.

result.p: The user signs in with the new phone. In the admin console, the user’s sign-in log shows a new MFA enrollment, dated today.

ul.li: Record the time of the enrollment in the ticket, and close it.
If the enrollment email doesn’t reach the user, reassign the ticket to the IAM team.
